notes.title: Free Buncle Melty Skin Available Now
notes.content:
Chocolate lovers rejoice, this free Farmagia “Melty” Buncle buddy skin is sure to satisfy your sweet tooth. 

Buncle attracts monsters by emitting a sweet smell from its brightly colored, jelly body, luring them in before ambushing. 

If you missed out on any of the previous free DLC, you can still get them today and expand your monster army!

notes.title: Free Kissie Honey Flan Skin Available Now
notes.content:
Our third free buddy skin DLC for Farmagia is... the “Honey Flan” Kissie. 

Don’t be fooled by its name, the Kissie’s elongated mouth delivers paralytic neurotoxins rather than kisses. 

Check back next week for another free buddy skin to keep your farm fresh!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3031500/Farmagia__Kissie_Skin_Honey_Flan/

notes.title: Free Griffie Great Sphinx Skin Available Now
notes.content:
This week’s free Farmagia buddy skin is the “Great Sphinx” for the Griffie. 

A winged beast with a natural preference for high places, Griffie attacks its enemies from the air with its sharp talons and beak. The monster is also known for collecting shiny objects they find. 

Another new skin will be available for free next week.  

Get growing, and take this Griffie out for adventure today! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3031490/Farmagia__Griffie_Skin_Great_Sphinx/

notes.title: Free Afanc Baby Tomato Skin Available Now
notes.content:
Starting today, Farmagia players can enjoy a new, free buddy skin every week during launch month! 

First up is the “Baby Tomato” skin for the Afanc. A bit of a prankster, Afanc delights in startling other monsters by shouting from the cover of a tree. When amplified by their magic microphone, their shouts can be powerful enough to cause their victim to faint. 

Download this skin, and expand your stable of monsters today! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3031480/Farmagia__Afanc_Skin_Baby_Tomato/
